utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s getting a solid turnout already. If you need a hand, I can point you to who’s organizing the trucks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean it already has trucks lined up, or is that still tentative?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not tentative anymore, from what I’m hearing. A few trucks are already lined up, and they’re still looking for more hands to help load them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. I'll try not to lose track of the changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep track of the changes and let you know what sticks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. Tell me what needs fixing on the drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I’ve got a few things on the drive that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I need gloves, flashlights, and a few boxes for the parts. If you can bring any spare screws or tape, that would help too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring gloves, a flashlight, and tape.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school pickup, but I need to know what time the repair crew is coming by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the crew time and let you know right after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Eli. I think the porch latch and one loose step need fixing, and I may be forgetting one more thing, but that’s the main bit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Tell me the third thing when it comes to you, and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, I'm spreading the word about the repair drive tonight, so you'll probably hear from a few people soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks for the heads-up. I’ll keep an ear out and make sure I’m actually available when people start reaching out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Good, I’ll keep passing the word along. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s moving along well, Nell. We’ve got the first repair sign-up sheet posted, and I can fill you in on the next volunteer window if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d help, thanks. When’s the next volunteer window?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly it’s the porch gate, the loose step on the front stoop, and a couple of leaky faucets. I’m keeping a list as people point things out, so if you hear of anything else, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear of anything else that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive, but I need to keep it quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take a look once it’s quiet enough.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll keep it quiet and be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a drill or a ladder if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That would help. Can I borrow the drill for the afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, you can borrow it for the afternoon. I’ll leave it by the front steps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive in mind. Where should I meet you, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Meet me by the side gate near the alley. I’ll be there around six.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll meet you by the side gate near the alley at six.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare drill and a ladder if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what I need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—just give me a shout when you know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should make sure the repair drive has a clear schedule and enough hands before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we have enough people lined up before we say yes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d rather wait until we know the roster and timing are solid; otherwise we risk overpromising.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can swing by after lunch and help organize the repair drive list if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Jules. I’ll keep the list ready for you after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll see you after lunch and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a box of zip ties, two flashlights, and a roll of tape I can bring over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can bring the extension cord and a couple of screwdrivers if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll grab the batteries and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they're still looking for folks to pitch in on the repair drive. I can ask around and pass along who’s got time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that, thanks. I’ll check our schedule and see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll let folks know you’re on board and see who else can help out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks. I’ll get the repair drive list organized and follow up with you on the first few homes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just send me the first few and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring the drive by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, I’ll have it ready when you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, Nell, and I’m spreading the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know. I’ll keep an ear out and tell folks I see.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell. I’ll keep nudging folks too, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the date.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where things are headed for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just keep it simple: I need a clear list of what goes where, and who’s handling each stop.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’ll make a simple stop-by-stop list and note who’s responsible for each one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much money do we need to raise, and what kind of repairs are included?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking that first so we don’t miss anything. Let me confirm the total amount and which repairs are actually covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, just tell me the total and what’s covered when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting some real momentum now. I can ask around while I’m out if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, if you could ask around for any spare tools or a ladder, that’d help a lot. I keep meaning to make a list and then I forget half of it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll ask around for spare tools and a ladder while I’m out.
